audit.privacy_note: No unrelated mailbox subjects, senders, bodies, attachments, credentials, tokens, or personal mailbox content are included.

findings.route_workflow: Email / SMS -> Inbox / Intake -> Sync new
findings.problem_friction: Sync new returned no new messages and cleared the visible uncommitted review queue.
findings.before_evidence: Authenticated QA 30-day scan returned three candidates; a no-new-message incremental sync left no queue summary or candidate cards. Candidate content is intentionally omitted.
findings.implemented_fix: Use parent-owned Gmail callbacks, merge incremental results by provider message ID, and preserve existing non-ready import status.
findings.after_evidence: tests/gmailCandidates.test.ts covers empty-result retention, deduplication, and status preservation; local branch checks pass.

findings.route_workflow: Procurement -> mixed-unit PO -> Record Delivery / Receipt
findings.problem_friction: An untouched zero quantity was rejected during a valid partial receipt even though the input allows zero.
findings.before_evidence: QA PO PO-QA-E2E-7F4K-001: 40 m and 20 bags plus an untouched 0 pcs line first failed; clearing the third input explicitly allowed the receipt.
findings.implemented_fix: Blank and zero UI values are skipped; only non-finite and negative quantities are invalid, with inline guidance.
findings.after_evidence: parseReceiptQuantity regression coverage passes and local mobile receipt cards render the no-op rule.

findings.problem_friction: The 1110px table hid source, amount, status, and correction actions behind horizontal scroll.
findings.before_evidence: Authenticated QA DOM metrics showed table width 1110px inside a 375px page; mobile capture exposed only the first columns.
findings.implemented_fix: Responsive ExpenseRegisterCard list below the large breakpoint with all essential fields and actions.
findings.after_evidence: Local 390px and 768px checks show cards, the desktop table hidden, and no page-level horizontal overflow.

findings.control_component: Purchase Order and RFQ register tables
findings.problem_friction: The PO register rendered at approximately 1270px and made row actions impractical on a phone.
findings.before_evidence: Authenticated QA DOM metrics showed a 1270px table inside a 341px scroller.
findings.implemented_fix: Responsive PO and RFQ register cards below the large breakpoint, preserving the existing actions and statuses.
findings.after_evidence: Local 390px and 768px checks show card registers and no page-level overflow; large screens retain tables.

findings.problem_friction: The Qty receiving input was beyond the mobile horizontal viewport.
findings.before_evidence: Authenticated QA mobile capture showed line description, ordered, and previous received columns while the quantity column was offscreen.
findings.implemented_fix: Mobile receipt line cards expose ordered, received, remaining, quantity input, and receive-remaining action vertically.
findings.after_evidence: Local 390px capture shows each quantity field directly beneath its line summary with no page overflow.

findings.problem_friction: The valid draft UUID was mistaken for an existing record and the blank form was titled Edit.
findings.before_evidence: Live QA New project form showed heading Edit while project code and name were blank.
findings.implemented_fix: A draft with no project code is labeled Create New Project; coded records retain their edit heading.
findings.after_evidence: Local dialog heading is Create New Project; project draft and heading regression tests pass.

findings.problem_friction: Secondary reconciliation allocation appeared before the Cash & Banking page title and primary actions.
findings.before_evidence: QA desktop DOM and capture showed reconciliation allocation before the Cash & Banking page heading.
findings.implemented_fix: Render Cash & Banking page header and summary before statement review and settlement allocation.
findings.after_evidence: Local route inspection reports Cash & Banking as the first main heading and allocation below it.

findings.problem_friction: Logo/company text and the centered document title/number box overlapped on mobile.
findings.before_evidence: QA mobile Client Invoice preview showed INVOICE colliding with the No box; desktop alignment was sound.
findings.implemented_fix: Stack branding and number on small screens, use fixed-layout wrapping in preview tables, and move focus into the modal with Escape/Tab handling.
findings.after_evidence: Local mobile preview shows separated branding, title, and number; preview client and scroll widths match, and the close control is the initial focus target.

findings.control_component: Gmail connection badge and scope notice
findings.problem_friction: Read-only wording could imply Compose cannot send outbound email.
findings.before_evidence: QA DOM and capture showed Read-only and Gmail is read-only on this screen.
findings.implemented_fix: Use Inbox access: read-only and direct outbound email to Compose and Delivery History.
findings.after_evidence: Local Email / SMS DOM contains the explicit inbox scope and Compose direction.

findings.problem_friction: The usable Email / SMS and Documents surface appeared only as a broad Planned item, obscuring the separate SMS dependency.
findings.before_evidence: QA Settings showed Email / SMS + Documents improvements as Planned while the top-level Email / SMS and Documents routes were live.
findings.implemented_fix: Expose Email and Documents workspace as available; keep SMS provider-backed messaging planned with the provider gate.
findings.after_evidence: Local Settings and demo assertions show Email/Documents under Available now and SMS under Planned.

findings.route_workflow: Generated Client Invoice PDF -> project/tax line
findings.problem_friction: The inspected PDF rendered a middle-dot separator as a replacement question mark before Tax.
findings.implemented_fix: Replace the renderer-sensitive middle dot with an ASCII hyphen in documentGeneration.ts.
findings.after_evidence: Renderer-safe separator regression test passes; high-fidelity converter remains truthfully unavailable on QA.
